test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 30th November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is a unicellular organism?
solution:
The correct answer is __**bacteria**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Unicellular organisms are made up of **single cells**. 

 
 
• They may be **eukaryotic or prokaryotic**.
 
• They can survive in any environment.
 
• They are so small cannot be seen with the naked eye.
 
• They reproduce **asexually**.
 
• Some unicellular organisms are **bacteria, protists, and yeast**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Multicellular organism**__

 
 
• These are the organism are consist of** more than one cell**.
 
• They are only **eukaryotic**.
 
• Reproduction takes place **sexually as well as asexually**.
 
• **Plants, animals, and birds** are examples.
 
• They are both microscopic and macroscopic.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2bf51191b964b4be3b4fc8f385188844f15ed22d2b751857f1dd48a3e0816e99.png]
